title: Keep in weather
line: Storm night on the coastal data-keep. Lightning hits the building first. Title.

title: Awakening
line: Green energy finds him after the building strike. Optic wakes. Born without a purpose. One face: spherical rust head, warm green eye left, empty socket right, crooked copper plate.

title: Born beside absence
line: Cut from the picture. The dust twin stays out — not a reshoot.

title: The dead phone
line: Wrong answer. Cracked phone ghosts August 2026 and WAKE PAIR — BAY 3. He aligns it like a mission card. Holds too long. Leaves to search how to fulfill it.

title: Rain on server glass
line: Wrong answer. Palm on storm glass. He matches the optic to a stubborn LED. The light does not hire him.

title: The unpulled lever
line: Wrong answer. He studies the caged lever as if pulling were the job. Leaves it. Will not wear a larger hand.

title: Faces that are not his
line: Wrong answer. Curling ID badges. None match. No face that owns a job for him.

title: Well of light
line: Spiral stair. Storm light above. He climbs — half-hoping purpose waits at the door.

title: The sag
line: Midway, power dips. He sits with the rain leak. Stands because he can.

title: Threshold
line: Roof door. Wind, salt, no work order waiting. He steps through. The path begins.

title: Gold seam / the door
line: Cut from the picture. Not a reshoot. No gold roof — threshold goes to the path.

title: Down the cliff
line: Cut from the picture. Not a reshoot. No plunge — threshold to path, then weather.

title: Path that was never printed
line: Goat trail. He looks back. The keep once held work orders; it does not call. He continues with the question.

title: Rain school
line: Rain hits the crooked plate in the open. The world wets him. It does not hire or fix him.

title: Moss that is not rust
line: Soft living green. Finger. Recoil. Same finger back. Unfinished grows without a bay order.

title: Tide pool looks back
line: A dish of sky. Something looks back. He almost scoops. Stops. He does not keep the pool.

title: Wind in grass
line: Grass lays and stands. Movement with no motor. Purpose still empty — ready to mistake the next contact for a job.

title: The theft
line: Almost a job. Storm-petrel pecks a copper flake. He follows as if reclaim were purpose.

title: The return
line: Nest ledge. Petrel drops the flake. He leaves it in shared space — care without owning. Warmth without meaning.

title: Fox at ten yards
line: Three-legged coastal fox. Recognition across wet rock. Leftover is not purpose. Nothing asks him yet. Purpose empty.

title: Sticky situation
line: Rising tide. Shared scrap tangle. Fox snared stump-side; petrel tangled in the same wire. Safe stone above. He sees both.

title: He chooses to help
line: He enters the channel at cost. Unweaves the bird. Braces the cable for the fox. Frees both. Does not own them.

title: Shared lee
line: Higher ground after weather. Fox, robot, petrel. Picture in the current cut; the story climax moves to the channel.

title: Absence rhymes
line: After help, empty socket and missing hind still rhyme. Neither fills the other. Help is not completion.

title: He does not go back
line: Keep small on the headland. He looks the way he looked at the lever. Leaves it having helped.

title: Horizon
line: He walks. Fox at a chosen distance. Petrel a dark hyphen. Purpose as habit: notice need, choose cost, free without owning. End card rustboy.ai.
